note: Ground truth labelled by a Claude agent from the Muse Voice Transcribe narration and 1 fps frames, blind to the model's plan; not yet human-reviewed. Uncertain: whether breaker on/off and voltage-tester steps count (shown on camera but off the work surface), and the exact twist/cut split for the ground wires (close-up shots at 70-80 s).

steps.instruction: Hold the yellow Sperry voltage tester to the wires in the box to check for current.
steps.done_looks_like: The tester tip is at the wires in the open blue box and its red light glows, showing the wires are live.
steps.evidence: [20.3] 'use a wire tester to test for current', [25.7] 'the wires are hot'; tester enters at t=23, lights red at t=29.

steps.instruction: Switch the breaker OFF, then re-test the box wires with the voltage tester.
steps.done_looks_like: The tester touches the wires in the box and stays dark.
steps.evidence: 'OFF' card and hand on breaker t=32-33; [34.5] 'Always test the wires before you touch them', tester at box t=34-37. Merged breaker-off and retest because the retest is the visible proof the breaker step is done.

steps.instruction: Pull the top and bottom sets of wires out of the box and spread them apart.
steps.done_looks_like: Bare, white and black wires fan out from the top and bottom of the blue box, none tied together.
steps.evidence: [38.1] 'spread out the two separate sets of wires'; hands spread wires t=42-44, spread state at t=45-46. t=47-64 is pointing and Ground/Neutral/Hot overlay cards, not hands-on, so left out.

steps.instruction: Twist the two bare ground wires together inside the box, leaving both ends long.
steps.done_looks_like: The two bare copper wires are twisted into one braid inside the box with two long tails.
steps.evidence: [65.3] 'twist the ground wires together ... leaving both ends long'; hands on both grounds t=68-69, pliers twisting in close-up t=70-72, long twisted tail visible t=72.

steps.instruction: Cut off one of the two ground-wire ends so a single bare ground wire is left.
steps.done_looks_like: Only one bare ground wire sticks out of the box.
steps.evidence: [75.7] 'cut one of the ends off', [80.9] 'leaves a single ground wire'; cutters in close-up t=75-77, single bare wire at top of box t=81.

steps.instruction: Bend a small hook into the end of the bare ground wire with pliers.
steps.done_looks_like: The single bare ground wire ends in a small U-shaped hook.
steps.evidence: [85.3] 'making a small hook'; hand on wire t=83-84, pliers bending t=85-88, hook visible t=89.

steps.instruction: Turn the breaker back ON and touch the tester to each black wire to find the LINE (hot) and LOAD wires.
steps.done_looks_like: The tester glows on the bottom black wire (LINE, from power source) and not on the top black wire (LOAD, to the light).
steps.evidence: 'ON' card t=90-93; [98.4] hot black from panel vs load; tester glows on bottom black t=99-103 with 'LINE (from power source)' card, top black t=104-106 with 'LOAD goes to the light fixture' card. Merged breaker-on with the test because the test is the purpose.

steps.instruction: Turn the breaker OFF again.
steps.done_looks_like: The circuit's breaker handle is in the OFF position.
steps.evidence: [108.7] 'turn the power back off'; hand on breaker with 'OFF' card t=109-112. Off the work surface, so low confidence it belongs in a top-down plan.

steps.instruction: Strip a little insulation off the tips of both white neutral wires with wire strippers.
steps.done_looks_like: Both white wires show short bare copper tips.
steps.evidence: [113.2] 'Starting with the white wires ... strip a little bit of the insulation off the tips'; strippers on white wires t=114-119.

steps.instruction: Twist the bare ends of the two white wires together.
steps.done_looks_like: The two white wires are joined by one twisted copper tip.
steps.evidence: [121.2] 'attach these two wires by twisting the ends together'; hands and pliers twisting t=121-127, twisted copper tip close-up t=128-130.

steps.instruction: Screw a wire nut (cream with red base) over the twisted white wires.
steps.done_looks_like: A cream/red wire nut caps the joined white wires, no copper showing.
steps.evidence: [129.7] 'secure using a wire nut'; nut twisted on t=131-133, finished nut t=134-135.

steps.instruction: Tuck the capped white wires neatly into the back of the box.
steps.done_looks_like: The wire nut and white wires sit inside the box; only the two black wires and the bare ground stick out.
steps.evidence: [134.6] 'neatly tucked inside the box'; hands pushing wires in t=136-138, tucked state t=139-141 (then LOAD/LINE/GROUND overlay t=142-144, not hands-on).

steps.instruction: Strip a little insulation off the tips of both black wires (LINE and LOAD).
steps.done_looks_like: Both black wires have short bare copper tips.
steps.evidence: [145.1] 'prepare the ends of the black wires by stripping'; strippers on the top black t=145-147, bottom black t=148-151.

steps.instruction: Bend a hook into the bare end of each black wire with pliers.
steps.done_looks_like: Three hooked wire ends stick out of the box: top black (LOAD), bare ground, bottom black (LINE).
steps.evidence: [152.8] 'create a hook on the bare ends of these two wires'; pliers bending t=152-157, hand adjusts t=158-159, three hooks visible t=160-161. Boundary with stripping at ~151.5 is approximate.

steps.instruction: Hook the bare ground wire clockwise around the green ground screw on the switch and tighten it.
steps.done_looks_like: The bare ground wire loops around the green ground screw, screw tightened down.
steps.evidence: [164.1] 'identify the ground screw ... painted green', [170.0] 'hook the bare ground wire around the ground screw ... clockwise'; green screw shown t=164-167, hooking t=169-174, screwdriver tightening t=176-183.

steps.instruction: Holding the switch upright, attach the black LINE (hot) wire to the bottom terminal screw and tighten it.
steps.done_looks_like: The bottom black wire is looped under the bottom brass terminal screw, screw tight.
steps.evidence: [184.7] 'secure the black hot wire that is the line wire to the bottom terminal screw'; bottom black hooked on t=190-192, screwdriver t=193-195, attached at t=196.

steps.instruction: Attach the black LOAD wire (to the light) to the top terminal screw and tighten it.
steps.done_looks_like: Both brass terminals hold a black wire: LOAD on top, LINE on bottom, ground on the green screw.
steps.evidence: [196.4] 'secure the black load wire ... on the top terminal'; top black hooked onto top screw t=198-204, tightened t=205-206.

steps.instruction: Turn the breaker ON and flip the switch toggle, touching only the toggle, to test it.
steps.done_looks_like: The wired switch hangs in front of the box and the toggle has been flipped up and down.
steps.evidence: [213.3] 'Turn the power back on', [216.0] 'only touch the toggle I test the function'; 'ON' card t=213-215, toggle flipped t=216-226. The light is not shown during this test. t=207-212 is the wired switch held up with no new action, left out.

steps.instruction: Turn the breaker OFF before mounting the switch.
steps.done_looks_like: The circuit's breaker handle is in the OFF position.
steps.evidence: [228.2] 'Turn the power back off'; 'OFF' card and hand on breaker t=228-231.

steps.instruction: Tuck the wires into the box and screw the switch into the box, keeping it straight.
steps.done_looks_like: The switch sits flush and vertical in the blue box with both mounting screws driven in.
steps.evidence: [231.8] 'tuck all the wires back into the box', [235.3] 'secure the switch by screwing it into place', [239.1] 'adjusting for straight position'; switch already in box at t=232 (tuck happens off-camera in the cut), driver on bottom screw t=233-235, top screw t=236-242, mounted at t=243. Merged tuck and screw because the tuck is not shown on its own.

steps.instruction: Put the white cover plate over the switch and tighten its two screws, without over-tightening.
steps.done_looks_like: A white single-toggle cover plate sits flat on the wall with both screws in.
steps.evidence: [243.7] 'install the cover plate and then tighten the screws'; plate placed t=244-246, screwdriver t=247-250.

steps.instruction: Turn the breaker back ON and flip the switch to turn on the ceiling light.
steps.done_looks_like: The switch toggle is flipped and the ceiling light fixture is lit.
steps.evidence: [250.9] 'finally turn the power back on'; 'ON' card t=251-254, toggle flipped t=256-257, ceiling light lit t=263-267 (end at 267 before the camera zooms into the glow).
